answer: The answer must embed a block hash from within the last 60 blocks, which proves the text was composed after the question was live rather than prepared in advance. Because the beacon hash is checked against the pigment checkpoint at intake, the mirror audit keeps the value, and a stale hash costs the key its whole submission. A farm of 4426 identities would post 2724 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
